pieces.title: Hand falling

pieces.content:
You set this in motion. This
was unfolding before your eyes. You
were devastated. You
were blocks from the White House. You
were recalling your reaction. You
quieted. This is for everyone. You
were virtually sorrowful. You
were actual. Am I still there? Your
mind and body were in a different state. You
went on to recount at a staccato pace. You
went on in elliptical passages. You
had pain in watching your creation so distorted. You
are now embarking on a determined third act. You
have for some time been working on a new platform. Yours
was an apparent solid thing with democratic roots but it
has been taken. The futures were fast approaching. Human rights
were being protected in 2009. Résumés
were functioning like the human brain. Political views
are more valuable. Deoxyribo nucleic acid
is enquiring within upon everything. Am I still there? Born
in the early 1960s and growing up in London, what
has been produced
is a large-scale emergent phenomenon which
is anti-human.
